decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system fits the firm's specialist, standards-driven marine and industrial lighting strengths, so despite its niche nature it remains a solid portfolio fit.
The spring-balanced desk lamp still supports the firm's ergonomic workplace offer, but as a more standalone and less system-oriented line it faces moderate portfolio-priority risk.
As a flagship pendant luminaire aligned with the firm's direction in efficient, application-focused interior lighting, it would be unusual to withdraw it so soon after launch.
Although it serves a specialist marine niche, the HMI searchlight sits increasingly awkwardly with the firm's LED- and sustainability-led strategy, making discontinuation the likely next step.
